title: Analysis of four long non-coding RNAs for hepatocellular carcinoma screening and prognosis by the aid of machine learning techniques.
summary: Machine-learning analysis of measured lncRNA expression in hepatocellular-carcinoma patients identifies four candidate markers for screening/prognosis.
ai_technology: The primary clinical sample includes 52 newly diagnosed HCC patients and 30 age-matched controls; serum lncRNA levels and ROC/prognostic analyses are reported.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Machine-learning analysis of measured lncRNA expression in hepatocellular-carcinoma patients identifies four candidate markers for screening/prognosis.
evidence.unknown: Small single-center sample; results support candidate markers and do not establish screening performance in practice.
